about.title: Plain honest work
paragraphs: Car Tech Auto Care has been taking care of Vancouver drivers for years. Peter, Miguel and the service crew check everything you ask about and give you a clear breakdown of parts and labor before the work starts.
If something else will need attention down the road, we'll tell you what it is and what it will cost, so there are no surprises.
about.photo_alt: Mechanic going over a repair with a customer

estimate.title: What's going on with your car?

estimate.thanks: Thanks! Peter will get back to you soon to set up a time.
